articles.title: DOG Mode explains Bitcoin's next governance fight
articles.snippet: Leonidas' DOG Mode client challenges Bitcoin's default relay policies, reopening a philosophical debate over censorship, free markets and who really governs the network.

articles.title: Stripe’s $53 billion PayPal bid is a high-stakes play to own the future of digital payments
articles.snippet: If Stripe acquires PayPal, the real prize could be consumer wallets, stablecoin issuance or the infrastructure powering the next generation of digital payments.
